Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
To ask Volkan to stop creating iconic Magic artwork would be like asking a fish to stop swimming—it’s just the way he is. With this drop, Volkan will have produced more than 200 pieces of Magic art. What an achievement! These are also the first-ever English-language cards to feature flavor text entirely in Volkan’s native German. Another momentous occasion! Celebrate this two-for-one by adding Volkan’s drop to your deck or collection today.

Contents:
• 1x Elspeth, Knight-Errant
• 1x Patron Wizard
• 1x Berserk
• 1x Verduran Enchantress
